//: Static hosting config for the Flutter Web release build. At deploy time this file is copied into app/build/web/ (the deployed directory) — it is not committed there because build/ is gitignored. Rewrites are fallbacks applied only when no static file matches, so main.dart.js / flutter.js / assets / canvaskit still serve directly; unknown deep-link paths fall back to the SPA entrypoint. No strict Content-Security-Policy: Flutter Web (CanvasKit + wasm) needs permissive script/wasm-eval, so we ship the achievable header set (HSTS + nosniff + frame denial + referrer policy) instead of a CSP that would break the app.
